articles.title: Policies for information security
articles.requirement: Information security policy and topic-specific policies defined, approved, published, reviewed

articles.title: Information security roles
articles.requirement: Information security roles and responsibilities assigned and documented

articles.title: Segregation of duties
articles.requirement: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility segregated to reduce opportunities for misuse

articles.title: Management responsibilities
articles.requirement: Management requires staff to apply information security per policies

articles.title: Contact with authorities
articles.requirement: Contacts with relevant authorities maintained and relevant information shared

articles.title: Contact with special interest groups
articles.requirement: Contacts with special interest groups or other security forums maintained

articles.title: Threat intelligence
articles.requirement: Information relating to information security threats collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence

articles.title: Information security in project management
articles.requirement: Information security integrated into project management

articles.title: Inventory of information and other assets
articles.requirement: Inventory of assets and other associated assets developed and maintained

articles.title: Acceptable use of information
articles.requirement: Rules for acceptable use and procedures for handling information assets identified, documented, implemented

articles.title: Return of assets
articles.requirement: Personnel and external parties return all assets upon termination or change of employment

articles.title: Classification of information
articles.requirement: Information classified according to organisational security needs, laws, obligations, and business criticality

articles.title: Labelling of information
articles.requirement: Appropriate set of procedures for information labelling developed and implemented

articles.title: Information transfer
articles.requirement: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements for all types of transfer within/outside organisation

articles.title: Access control
articles.requirement: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and assets based on business and security requirements

articles.title: Identity management
articles.requirement: Full lifecycle of identities managed — allocation, maintenance, revocation

articles.title: Authentication information
articles.requirement: Allocation and management of authentication information controlled by management process

articles.title: Access rights
articles.requirement: Access rights provisioned, reviewed, modified, removed per topic-specific access control policy

articles.title: Information security in supplier relationships
articles.requirement: Processes and procedures defined and implemented for managing information security risks with supplier relationships

articles.title: Addressing security within supplier agreements
articles.requirement: Relevant security requirements established and agreed with each supplier based on type of relationship

articles.title: Security in ICT supply chain
articles.requirement: Processes defined and implemented to manage security risks in ICT supply chain

articles.title: Monitoring and review of supplier services
articles.requirement: Regular monitoring, review, audit of supplier security practices and service delivery

articles.title: Security for cloud services
articles.requirement: Processes for acquisition, use, management, exit of cloud services established per information security requirements

articles.title: Information security incident management planning
articles.requirement: Planning, preparation, roles and responsibilities for effective response to information security incidents

articles.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
articles.requirement: Assess security events and decide whether to classify as incidents

articles.title: Response to information security incidents
articles.requirement: Incidents responded to in accordance with documented procedures

articles.title: Learning from incidents
articles.requirement: Knowledge gained from incidents used to reduce likelihood or impact of future incidents

articles.title: Collection of evidence
articles.requirement: Procedures for identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence

articles.title: Information security during disruption
articles.requirement: Information security during disruption planned and security measures maintained or adapted

articles.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
articles.requirement: ICT readiness planned, implemented, maintained, tested based on BCM and recovery objectives

articles.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory, contractual requirements
articles.requirement: Legal, statutory, regulatory, contractual requirements relevant to information security identified

articles.title: Intellectual property rights
articles.requirement: Procedures to protect intellectual property rights implemented

articles.title: Protection of records
articles.requirement: Records protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access, and release

articles.title: Privacy and protection of personal data
articles.requirement: Privacy and protection of personal data required by applicable laws/regulations implemented

articles.title: Independent review of information security
articles.requirement: Organisation's approach to information security and implementation reviewed independently at planned intervals

articles.title: Compliance with policies and standards
articles.requirement: Compliance with information security policy, topic-specific policies, standards reviewed regularly

articles.title: Documented operating procedures
articles.requirement: Operating procedures for information processing facilities documented and available to personnel

articles.title: Screening
articles.requirement: Pre-employment and ongoing background checks on personnel proportional to access and classification

articles.title: Terms and conditions of employment
articles.requirement: Employment contracts include information security responsibilities; personnel acknowledge obligations

articles.title: Information security awareness, education, training
articles.requirement: Staff receive regular security awareness training; role-specific training; phishing simulation

articles.title: Disciplinary process
articles.requirement: Formal disciplinary process for personnel who have committed information security policy violations

articles.title: Responsibilities after termination or change
articles.requirement: Information security responsibilities remain valid after termination; NDAs persist

articles.title: Confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements
articles.requirement: NDAs/confidentiality agreements used where business need; regularly reviewed

articles.title: Remote working
articles.requirement: Security measures for remote working including access, equipment, and physical environment

articles.title: Information security event reporting
articles.requirement: Personnel can and are required to report information security events promptly via appropriate channels

articles.title: Physical security perimeters
articles.requirement: Defined and used to protect areas containing sensitive information and assets

articles.title: Physical entry
articles.requirement: Secure areas protected by appropriate entry controls and access points

articles.title: Securing offices, rooms, facilities
articles.requirement: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities designed and implemented

articles.title: Physical security monitoring
articles.requirement: Premises monitored for unauthorised physical access

articles.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
articles.requirement: Protection against physical threats (fire, flood, earthquake, etc.) designed and implemented

articles.title: Working in secure areas
articles.requirement: Security measures for working in secure areas designed and applied

articles.title: Clear desk and clear screen
articles.requirement: Clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media; clear screen policy for IT facilities

articles.title: Equipment siting and protection
articles.requirement: Equipment sited and protected to reduce risks from environmental and physical threats

articles.title: Security of assets off-premises
articles.requirement: Off-site assets protected considering the risks of working outside organisation premises

articles.title: Storage media
articles.requirement: Storage media managed through lifecycle — acquisition, use, transport, disposal

articles.title: Supporting utilities
articles.requirement: Information processing facilities protected from power failures and disruptions from utilities

articles.title: Cabling security
articles.requirement: Cables carrying power, data, or supporting services protected from interception, interference, damage

articles.title: Equipment maintenance
articles.requirement: Equipment maintained to ensure availability and integrity of information

articles.title: Secure disposal or re-use
articles.requirement: Items containing storage media verified to ensure any sensitive data removed/overwritten before disposal

articles.title: User endpoint devices
articles.requirement: User endpoint devices secured and managed throughout lifecycle; MDM/endpoint protection

articles.title: Privileged access rights
articles.requirement: Allocation and use of privileged access rights restricted and managed per access control policy

articles.title: Information access restriction
articles.requirement: Access to information and other associated assets restricted per access control policy

articles.title: Access to source code
articles.requirement: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries managed appropriately

articles.title: Secure authentication
articles.requirement: Secure authentication technologies and procedures implemented based on information access restrictions

articles.title: Capacity management
articles.requirement: Use of resources monitored and adjusted to meet capacity and performance requirements

articles.title: Protection against malware
articles.requirement: Protection against malware implemented and supported by user awareness

articles.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
articles.requirement: Technical vulnerabilities of information systems managed — inventory, patching, risk assessment

articles.title: Configuration management
articles.requirement: Configurations including security configurations of hardware, software, services, networks established, documented, monitored, reviewed

articles.title: Information deletion
articles.requirement: Information stored in information systems, devices or other storage media deleted when no longer required

articles.title: Data masking
articles.requirement: Data masking used in accordance with policy and other topic-specific requirements on access control

articles.title: Data leakage prevention
articles.requirement: Data leakage prevention measures applied to systems, networks, and devices

articles.title: Information backup
articles.requirement: Backup copies of information, software, and systems maintained and tested regularly per backup policy

articles.title: Redundancy
articles.requirement: Sufficient redundancy in information processing facilities to meet availability requirements

articles.title: Logging
articles.requirement: Logs that record activities, exceptions, errors, and other relevant events produced, stored, protected, analysed

articles.title: Monitoring activities
articles.requirement: Networks, systems, applications monitored for anomalous behaviour and to evaluate potential incidents

articles.title: Clock synchronisation
articles.requirement: Clocks of information processing systems synchronised to approved time sources

articles.title: Use of privileged utility programs
articles.requirement: Use of utility programs that might override system and application controls restricted and controlled

articles.title: Installation of software on operational systems
articles.requirement: Procedures and measures to securely manage software installation on operational systems

articles.title: Networks security
articles.requirement: Networks and network devices secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems

articles.title: Security of network services
articles.requirement: Security mechanisms, service levels, and management requirements for network services identified, implemented, monitored

articles.title: Segregation of networks
articles.requirement: Groups of information services, users, and information systems segregated in the network

articles.title: Web filtering
articles.requirement: Access to external websites managed to reduce exposure to malicious content

articles.title: Use of cryptography
articles.requirement: Rules for effective use of cryptography including cryptographic key management defined and implemented

articles.title: Secure development lifecycle
articles.requirement: Rules for secure development of software and systems established and applied; SSDLC

articles.title: Application security requirements
articles.requirement: Security requirements identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications

articles.title: Secure system architecture and engineering
articles.requirement: Principles for engineering secure systems established, documented, maintained, applied

articles.title: Secure coding
articles.requirement: Secure coding principles applied to software development; code review; SAST/DAST

articles.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
articles.requirement: Security testing processes defined and implemented in development lifecycle

articles.title: Outsourced development
articles.requirement: Outsourced system development supervised and monitored; security requirements in contracts

articles.title: Separation of development, test, production
articles.requirement: Development, testing, and production environments separated and secured

articles.title: Change management
articles.requirement: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems subject to change management procedures

articles.title: Test information
articles.requirement: Test information selected, protected, managed; personal data not used in test environments unless protected

articles.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
articles.requirement: Audit tests and activities involving assessment of operational systems planned and agreed to minimise disruptions
